extension.summary: Blurred backgrounds, online ratings, spoiler-free stills, keymaps and faster info pages for the Bald skin.
extension.description: The companion service for the Bald skin. It makes Bald's blurred backgrounds, fetches online ratings from MDbList (add your free API key in the settings), frosts the stills of unwatched episodes when spoiler protection is on, and runs Bald's info page and library actions quickly. It does nothing under other skins.
